modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On June 27, 1976: Air France Flight 139 (Tel Aviv-Athens-Paris) is hijacked en route to Paris by the PFLP and redirected to Entebbe, Uganda.
On June 27, 1995: Space Shuttle Atlantis launches on STS-71, the first space shuttle mission to dock with the Russian space station Mir.
On June 27, 1954: The Obninsk Nuclear Power Plant, the Soviet Union's first nuclear power station, opens in Obninsk, near Moscow.
On June 27, 1898: The first solo circumnavigation of the globe is completed by Joshua Slocum from Briar Island, Nova Scotia.
June 27 is observed as Commemoration Day for the Victims of the Communist Regime (Czech Republic).
